cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.

mechanism: Copy packing a large trophy without knowing the case is being emptied, then convert a consolation prize into successive victories of portability and display flexibility.
confusable: Not simply praising a small object: B must supply an apparent loss and A must keep proposing comparative tests that reverse it.
comparison: Award presentation and transport, rather than a race-course shortcut.
seedUse: Retains small consolation trophy/storage/modesty; adds misread large carrying case.
